note: mock_rate encodes the IDEAL outcome so `--decider mock` demonstrates the pipeline; real deciders (api/claude-cli) ignore it and measure the description. audit-plan chooses WHICH of the twenty-two audits a project needs and in what order, and emits paste-ready invocations. The discriminator against audit-run is scope — programme versus one audit — and against migration-plan / refactor-plan it is that nothing is being changed: the output is an assessment programme, not a remediation plan.
